items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Yeah, sometime I worked with him, but I never just played in his band. I used to play extra sometimes.

ctx.x: About five foot ten. I always thought maybe he was a little fella. I guess Buddy Petit was real little.
Oh, now that's the little, that was the little man. Buddy Petit and Rene. Yeah. Them was little fellas.
I saw Rene, I remember he's small.

items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Then when Titin died, he started playing trombone.

ctx.x: He used to play bass, he used to play clarinet. Then when Titin died, he started playing trombone.
Did you have any teacher on the guitar when you started?
